name: Endless Loop
description: Not a published list: MirrorMorph: Endless Iteration's deck, built in Downfall Stage 8 so the sweeps reach a Corp whose first three actions are told apart (the turn log's kinds of action) and an action taken on condition it is a different one. On Retirement Package's frame, Haas-Bioroid's own cards, whose clicks to gain, install, advance, draw and play are each a different action; Retirement Package keeps every card. Eternal-legal: the frame's Core Set cards keep it out of Standard. Tranche 8 Stage 5a: two NEXT Bronze for its two Drafter, a code gate one stronger for each rezzed piece of NEXT ice; Retirement Package keeps Drafter. Tranche 8 Stage 6b: two Project Vitruvius for its two Midnight-3 Arcology, point for point, an agenda whose counters past three bring a card back from Archives, and two Biotic Labor for its two Corporate Hospitality, two clicks for four credits; Retirement Package keeps both. Tranche 8 Stage 9d: two NEXT Silver for its two Hákarl 1.0, barrier for barrier, beside the NEXT Bronze it counts; Hákarl 1.0 is still in other decks.
